rules.text: Front-load the most important genre, vocal identity and groove behavior; do not hide them behind long harmony or production prose.
rules.source: Suno Field Guide + v6 community observations

rules.text: Use a structured production brief rather than a long tag cloud. Keep critical requirements conceptually separated and avoid conflicting descriptors.
Keep unwanted styles/vocals in the separate Exclude/negative field when available; do not mix a large negative list into the positive style prompt.
rules.source: Suno Lyrics Skill + Suno Create workflows

rules.text: Use clear section tags in the Lyrics field; tags organize structure, but do not assume every community-only modifier is deterministic.
For v6, prefer specific musical behaviors and arrangement intent over piles of adjectives. Treat community syntax tricks as probabilistic, not hidden guaranteed commands.
rules.source: Suno v6 release/help + current community testing

rules.text: When exact recurring singer identity matters, prefer an approved Suno Persona/Voice/reference workflow; text prompts mainly stabilize behavior and phonation coordinates.
Keep the style prompt compact enough to avoid dilution. Channel presets may enforce their own tighter word/character target.
Describe musical traits instead of requesting imitation or soundalike output of a named living artist or copyrighted song.
Record generated-result feedback (KEEP/REGEN plus failure reason) and favor recipes that repeatedly work for the user's own channels over generic internet recipes.
